visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a colorful patterned hoodie and a blue skirt stands on a city sidewalk next to a large tan-colored camper van. She points towards the vehicle while smiling. The background shows multi-story residential buildings and a wet pavement suggesting recent rain. (2) The scene shifts inside the vehicle where a woman with short dark hair in a plaid shirt waves enthusiastically at the camera. She is standing in a narrow hallway lined with wooden cabinets. A person wearing a black mask is partially visible behind her. (3) The camera pans to reveal the main living area of the RV, featuring a central wooden table surrounded by seating with leopard-print cushions. Various items like a pink bag and a remote are on the table. (4) The woman in the plaid shirt is now outside again, standing by the open sliding door of the van, gesturing with both arms wide as if welcoming someone. She is wearing a brown crossbody bag. (5) Back inside, another woman in a lavender-pink oversized sweatshirt demonstrates the bathroom facilities. She slides a grey tambour door shut to show the enclosed space, then points out the toilet and a black handheld showerhead. (6) The woman in the pink sweatshirt opens upper storage cabinets with roller shutters and checks the kitchen area. She points at the gas stove burners and opens a small oven below, then opens a medium-sized refrigerator filled with canned drinks and bottles of wine. (7) The video concludes with the woman in the plaid shirt speaking directly to the camera in a close-up shot, her expressions shifting as she explains her perspective on owning the vehicle.
